_comment: Mobile test sharding for @qvac/tts-ggml. The mobile CI action auto-detects this file and runs ONLY the tests listed here (Mocha --grep per group). runRtfBenchmarkTest and runStreamingBenchmarkTest are intentionally NOT listed: they are perf benchmarks (see perf-tests.json) that must not run on normal mobile runs, so they can never produce a 0/0 result. To run them, use perf-only mode (qvac_perf_only / QVAC_PERF_ONLY=true), which filters to perf-tests.json. Only the 'ios' and 'android' keys are consumed by the action; this _comment is ignored.
